history_policy: This version hash-inherits every V6 decision and adds Temporal as an explicitly availability-gated capability family. Any later workload, boundary, jobs, checksum, metric, or acceptance change creates another version.
change: Moves temporal from deferred to an implemented zig-js capability family. Every run proves the declared availability profile (zig-js exposes the required constructors and system JSC does not) before reporting JavaScriptCore as N/A rather than conditionally changing the scored workload.

implemented_families_append.surface: Temporal.PlainDate construction/addition, Temporal.Instant parse/addition, and Temporal.Duration construction/total over deterministic ISO/UTC inputs

JavaScriptCore.result: N/A: system JSC public JSGlobalContext does not expose the required Temporal namespace

implemented_families_append.anti_specialization: Separate forward and reverse implementations change identifiers, object property order, operation order, and loop direction while applying the same date and instant deltas and producing the same exact checksum.
